context: Two friends discuss a sports YouTube channel and training tips
purpose: Teach: コーチ/狙っ/天才/回数/アルバイト/チャンネル/加速/盛ん

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最近、テニスのYouTubeチャンネルにハマってて、毎晩観てるんだ。
lines.en: Lately I've been hooked on a tennis YouTube channel, watching it every night.
lines.style: Casual upbeat tone, slightly geeky enthusiasm from a university student sharing a new hobby.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: へえ、どんな感じ？コーチがちゃんと教えてくれるやつ？
lines.en: Oh yeah? What's it like? One where a coach actually teaches you properly?
lines.style: Curious teenage voice, leaning in with genuine interest, casual and quick.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、元プロの人がやってて、フォームの解説とか天才的にわかりやすいんだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, a former pro runs it, and his form explanations are brilliantly clear.
lines.style: Admiring tone, slightly impressed, speaking with the confidence of a fan recommending something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいなあ。俺もサーブの精度上げたくて、コーナー狙って打つ練習してるんだ。
lines.en: Nice. I've been practicing aiming for the corners to improve my serve accuracy.
lines.style: Earnest teenage athlete tone, slightly proud but mostly focused and determined.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その動画でも言ってたけど、回数こなすより質を意識した方が一気に加速するらしいよ。
lines.en: The video said the same — focusing on quality over quantity makes your progress accelerate fast.
lines.style: Sharing insider knowledge tone, half-quoting the channel, with thoughtful pacing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: なるほどなあ。最近うちの高校でもテニス部めっちゃ盛んでさ、レベル上がってきてるんだよ。
lines.en: Makes sense. The tennis club at my high school is really thriving lately, and the level keeps rising.
lines.style: Slightly boastful but friendly teenage energy, sharing local pride with casual rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ俺もアルバイトの休みの日、一緒に打ちに行こうかな。
lines.en: Then maybe on my day off from my part-time job, I'll come hit some balls with you.
lines.style: Friendly invitation tone, relaxed and warm, suggesting a casual plan between friends.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ぜひ来てよ！そのチャンネルの先生の真似、一緒に試してみたい。
lines.en: Please come! I want to try imitating that channel's instructor together with you.
lines.style: Eager and bright teenage tone, excited about a shared activity with an older friend.
